notes: All six Common Crawl captures (CC-MAIN-2017-47) of UBC Sauder 'PhD in Business Administration / Alumni / <year>' pages were readable tables with columns Name | Current University | Division (2014 page: Specialization). Each page is headed 'UBC PhD Alumni <year>'; the pages do not state whether the year is the graduation year, so yearMeaning is 'unstated' (the 2014 page's intro says 'Since graduating its first student in 1972 ... PhD Program has seen over 300 students proceed to academic, government, and industry positions', which makes graduation year the likely meaning). The 'Current University' column is a current affiliation as of the page (Last Updated on 9/20/2017), recorded in destination for reference only; it is not a first job. The division/specialization codes (ACC, FIN, MIS, MKT, OB, POL, SC, SBE, INT, IB, TRANS) are kept in note; SC on these pages most likely means the Management Science specialization (the UBC operations group), which is the population of interest. Email addresses printed beside some names were deliberately omitted (personal contact details). Every table row is a named alumnus; no faculty, advisors, current students or master's graduates appear on these pages. No live copy was provided for any page.
